evidence: The lm growth is shown to be self-limiting and linear over a range of deposition temperatures. The structure and properties of the lm is tuned by varying the deposition and post-treatment conditions, and the electrochemical performance of the lms is characterized. The lms exhibit higher ionic conductivity than any previously reported ALD lm ( >10 /C0 6 Sc m /C0 1 at 25 /C14 C) with a high ionic transference number of >0.9999, and are shown to be stable over a wide range of potentials relevant for solid-state batteries.
